statement.p: The figure below shows a contour map of a hill with two paths, A and B. The heights on the contours are z = z_0 = 100, z = z_1 = 175, and z = z_2 = 250.

(a) On which path, A or B, will you have to climb more steeply?
?
A
B

(b) On which path, A or B, will you probably have a better view of the surrounding countryside? (Assuming trees do not block your view.)
?
A
B

(c) Alongside which path is there more likely to be a stream?
?
A
B

static.solution:
(a) The contour lines are much closer together on path B, so path B is steeper.
(b) If you are on path B and turn around to look at the countryside, you find hills to your left and right, obscuring the view. But the ground falls away on either side of path A, so you are likely to get a much better view of the countryside from path A
(c) There is more likely to be a stream alongside path B, because water follows the direction of steepest descent.
